title: Noise stability and agreement probability
statement: For every $\rho\in[-1,1]$ and every Boolean function $f$, its noise stability after interpreting its outputs as real signs is twice the probability that its values agree on a correlated pair of inputs, minus one.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean function on the Boolean cube
